instruction: Star all emails in the local Bills folder and create a message filter that automatically stars incoming emails with 'Invoice' in the subject.

llm_judge_reasons: Starring check is semantically correct: getter reads Bills mbox, parses X-Mozilla-Status header, checks bit 0x0004 (flagged/starred), and excludes deleted messages (bit 0x0008). This sub-check is sound and sufficient.

Filter check now correctly requires BOTH 'Mark flagged' (action) AND 'Invoice' (subject condition) to appear within the same rule block (split on blank lines). The prior critical gap — unverified subject condition — has been addressed by Fix 1 in fix_history.
Metric awards 0.5 per sub-goal with partial credit, which is appropriate for the two-part instruction.

Minor residual risk: the blank-line block-split is a heuristic that depends on Thunderbird's actual msgFilterRules.dat formatting. If Thunderbird does not separate rules with blank lines, the entire file is treated as one block, which would still find the strings but could yield a false positive if two separate, unrelated rules together contain 'Invoice' and 'Mark flagged'.

Minor gap: the filter trigger type (incoming vs. manual/scheduled/outgoing) is not verified; any rule block with 'Mark flagged' + 'Invoice' will pass regardless of when the filter fires. In practice, Thunderbird defaults new filters to 'incoming', so this is low risk.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optional hardening: also verify the filter's trigger type by checking for a condition like 'type="17"' (incoming) or parsing the 'type=' field to ensure the filter applies to incoming mail.
Optional hardening: if Thunderbird's msgFilterRules.dat version is known, use a format-aware parser instead of a blank-line heuristic to correctly isolate individual rule entries.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully starred all 2 emails in Bills folder using Ctrl+A to select all, then right-click > Mark > Add Star.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can select all emails and star them; can create message filters via Tools > Message Filters with 'Mark flagged' action.
metadata.explanation: Chains the original starring task with a filter-creation objective. The agent must both star existing emails AND create a filter (via Tools > Message Filters) with a 'Mark flagged' action for emails with 'Invoice' in the subject. Evaluator checks (1) all Bills mbox messages have starred bit set (X-Mozilla-Status bit 0x0004), (2) msgFilterRules.dat contains a single rule block with both 'Mark flagged' action AND 'Invoice' condition — ensuring the filter targets the correct subject. [Fixed: getter now parses msgFilterRules.dat by rule blocks and requires both 'Invoice' and 'Mark flagged' to appear in the same block, preventing false passes from unrelated 'Mark flagged' filters.]
fix_history: Fix 1: Updated getter to parse msgFilterRules.dat into rule blocks (split on blank lines) and require that a single block contains BOTH 'Mark flagged' (action) AND 'Invoice' (subject condition), rather than just checking for 'Mark flagged' anywhere in the file.
